tools.name: check_feed
tools.description: Check up to 20 CSV product records for structural issues. Send only redacted product data, no personal or secret fields. No URLs fetched; no input stored.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Returns the paused sales status without a purchase link.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_feed" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check up to 20 CSV product records for structural issues. Send only redacted product data, no personal or secret fields. No URLs fetched; no input stored.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_feed · Private data: check_feed · Public sink: check_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_feed · Private data: check_feed · Public sink: check_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
